messages:
Morgan: Quick planning — trying to lock a 60m engineering sync to run through API changes (surface/shapes), SDK ergonomics, and Console UX updates. Proposed slots: Tue 10:00 PT or Wed 15:00 PT. Thoughts? need 2 reviewers + PM.

Alex: Tue works for me, prefer 10 if we can get design in the first half.

Priya: Wed is better for me, otherwise I'll be on support rotation. If Tue wins, I can still record and send notes.

Sam: +1 to recording. Also can someone add clear target outcomes? let's avoid open-ended "feedback" only.

Jamie: I can own Console UX section. Proposal: 45m review + 15m action items & rollout plan.

Morgan: Read-ahead checklist (please ack with :white_check_mark: when done):
```
Read-ahead (drop a quick ack in thread):
- RFC: https://redwood.internal/docs/rfcs/2026-03-api-shape (one-pager summary)
- SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/412 (diff + usage doc)
- Console mocks: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (Console > API flows, pages 2-4)
- Test plan highlights: https://redwood.internal/docs/tests/api-migration (short bullets)
```

Eva: Acked the RFC, left a couple tiny comments on the SDK PR. Will prep a 3-slide migration note.

Morgan: If you can't make the meeting, please add notes in the docs or assign a delegate. Also add any must-have checklist items to the SDK PR. I'll send a calendar invite once slot is final. :calendar:

Alex: :white_check_mark: for Tue. @Priya can you confirm before EOD?

Priya: Confirmed Wed-only, apologies. I'll record + post notes if the group goes with Tue.

Sam: Quick tally: I'm for Tue 10:00 PT. @Jamie?

Jamie: Tue > Wed for me too. +1 to Tue 10:00 PT. Morgan please lock and include the agenda + links in the invite.

Morgan: Locking Tue 10:00 PT then. Invite incoming with agenda and the checklist pinned in the event. If you need to delegate, add their name in the calendar RSVP. Thanks all :rocket:
